question: A sum of money kept at simple interest amounts to Rs. 820 in 3 years and to Rs. 894 in 4 years. What will be the interest accumulated after 9 years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Amount of 4 years = 894

Amount of 3 years = 820

Amount in 1 year = 894 - 820

⇒ 74, which is also the simple interest earned in one year on the principal amount.

Interest accumulated in 9 years, 

⇒ 9 × 74 = Rs. 666

**Hence, the correct is Rs. 666**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount at simple interest in 3 years = Rs. 820

Amount at simple interest in 4 years = Rs. 894

Time = 9 years

**Concept used:**

S.I = (PRT)/(100)

A = P + S.I

Where, A = Final amount, P = principal, R = rate of interest, and T = time of investment

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

P + (PR(3))/(100) = 820

⇒ P(1 + (3R)/(100)) = 820 ----(1)

Similarly, P(1 + (4R)/(100)) = 894 ----(2)

On dividing the equation (2) by (1), we get,

⇒ (1 + 4R/100)over(1+3R/100) = 894over820

⇒ 100+4R over100 +3R = 447over410

⇒ 41000 + 1640R = 44700 + 1341R

⇒ 3700 = 299R

⇒ R = (3700)/(299)%

Now, on substituting the value of R in equation (1) or (2), we get,

⇒ P = (820 × 299)/(410)

Again according to the question,

Time = 9 years, Simple Interest will be

⇒ S.I = (820 × 299)/(410) × (3700)/(299) × 9 × (1)/(100)

⇒ S.I = 666

**Hence, Rs. 666 is the required answer.**
